sql-pre-query.name: sql-pre-query
sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

/* [RT 12/11] staging + RENAME swap: IOC không bao giờ thấy bảng rỗng/đang sửa dở */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan__stg;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan__stg

SELECT
    t.monthkey,
		t.`year`,
		t.don_vi_cap_01,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		t.NgayVanBan,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,

    /* Tổng số nhiệm vụ */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* ===== ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_dh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_kh,

    /* ===== CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_th,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_sqh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(t.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(t.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_khoi t
WHERE NOT ( t.NhomGiaoNhan = 'Được giao' AND t.loaicapcha = "Thành ủy Hà Nội")
GROUP BY
    t.monthkey,
		t.don_vi_cap_01,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,
    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.NhomGiaoNhan

		
UNION ALL

SELECT
 t.monthkey,
 LEFT(t.monthkey,4) `year`,
 "THÀNH PHỐ HÀ NỘI" AS don_vi_cap_01,
 "Thành ủy Hà Nội" AS loaicapcha,

 t.loai_nhiem_vu_viettat AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
 NULL AS NgayVanBan,
'Chưa xác định' AS LinhVuc,
'Chưa xác định' AS Kieu,
'Chưa xác định' AS UuTien,
SUM( t.tong_so_nhiem_vu) AS tongso,
SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh) AS daht,
SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh_dung_han) AS daht_dh,
SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh_qua_han) AS daht_qh,
0 AS daht_kh,
SUM( t.on_dinh_dung_han) + SUM( t.thuong_xuyen) + SUM( t.dang_tien_hanh_qua_han) AS dangth,
SUM( t.on_dinh_dung_han) + SUM( t.thuong_xuyen) AS dangth_th,
SUM( t.dang_tien_hanh_qua_han) AS dangth_qh,
SUM( t.sap_den_han) AS dangth_sqh,
0 AS dangth_kh,
NULL AS tongtg_canxuly,
NULL AS tongtg_daxuly,
t.nhom_nhiem_vu AS nhomvb_ma,
CONCAT('Nghị quyết ',LEFT(t.nhom_nhiem_vu,2)) AS nhomvb,
'Nhiệm vụ ngoài khối' AS NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
'Được giao' AS NhomGiaoNhan,
MAX( t.syncdate)
FROM datamart_hanoi.tla_bao_cao_tong_quan t
WHERE t.monthkey IN (
    SELECT MAX(t1.monthkey)
    FROM datamart_hanoi.tla_bao_cao_tong_quan t1
		GROUP BY LEFT(t1.monthkey, 4)
)
GROUP BY 
 t.monthkey,
 t.loai_nhiem_vu_viettat,
 t.nhom_nhiem_vu
		
ORDER BY 
    monthkey,
		don_vi_cap_01,
    loaicapcha,
    VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    LinhVuc,
    Kieu,
		UuTien,
    nhomvb_ma,
    nhomvb,
		NhomGiaoNhan,
		NhomPhamViNhiemVu
;
/* Đổi chỗ nguyên tử; chờ khóa tối đa 10s để không chặn dashboard */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan__stg;

sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

JDBC Connection Pool.name: JDBC Connection Pool
JDBC Connection Pool.description: Specifies the JDBC Connection Pool to use in order to convert the JSON message to a SQL statement. The Connection Pool is necessary in order to determine the appropriate database column types.

putsql-sql-statement.name: putsql-sql-statement
putsql-sql-statement.description: The SQL statement to execute. The statement can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming FlowFiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming FlowFile is expected to contain a valid SQL statement, to be issued by the processor to the database.

Support Fragmented Transactions.name: Support Fragmented Transactions
Support Fragmented Transactions.description: If true, when a FlowFile is consumed by this Processor, the Processor will first check the fragment.identifier and fragment.count attributes of that FlowFile. If the fragment.count value is greater than 1, the Processor will not process any FlowFile with that fragment.identifier until all are available; at that point, it will process all FlowFiles with that fragment.identifier as a single transaction, in the order specified by the FlowFiles' fragment.index attributes. This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. If this value is false, these attributes will be ignored and the updates will occur independent of one another.

database-session-autocommit.name: database-session-autocommit
database-session-autocommit.description: The autocommit mode to set on the database connection being used. If set to false, the operation(s) will be explicitly committed or rolled back (based on success or failure respectively), if set to true the driver/database handles the commit/rollback.

Transaction Timeout.name: Transaction Timeout
Transaction Timeout.description: If the <Support Fragmented Transactions> property is set to true, specifies how long to wait for all FlowFiles for a particular fragment.identifier attribute to arrive before just transferring all of the FlowFiles with that identifier to the 'failure' relationship

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The preferred number of FlowFiles to put to the database in a single transaction

Obtain Generated Keys.name: Obtain Generated Keys
Obtain Generated Keys.description: If true, any key that is automatically generated by the database will be added to the FlowFile that generated it using the sql.generate.key attribute. This may result in slightly slower performance and is not supported by all databases.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

    END AS NhomPhamViNhiemVu,

		CASE
				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN

				ELSE

				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN 'HT đúng hạn'
				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'
        ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
    END AS TrangThaiVietTat,
		CASE
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'

        ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
    END AS TrangThaiVietTat2,
		NULL AS TenNhiemVu_Mobile,
		'${sync_ts}' AS syncdate
FROM (
    SELECT
        /* 01 - monthkey: lấy theo ExpireDate dạng YYYYMM */
        DATE_FORMAT( COALESCE( t.CompletedDate, t.ExpireDate, t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m') + 0 AS monthkey,
        DATE_FORMAT( COALESCE( t.CompletedDate, t.ExpireDate, t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m%d') + 0 AS `date`,

						ELSE COALESCE(rg4.`Name`, rg3.`Name`, rg2.`Name`, rg1.`Name`, rg.`Name`)

        rg.ResolutionGroupId AS nhomvb_ma,

JDBC Connection Pool.name: JDBC Connection Pool
JDBC Connection Pool.description: Specifies the JDBC Connection Pool to use in order to convert the JSON message to a SQL statement. The Connection Pool is necessary in order to determine the appropriate database column types.

putsql-sql-statement.name: putsql-sql-statement
putsql-sql-statement.description: The SQL statement to execute. The statement can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming FlowFiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming FlowFile is expected to contain a valid SQL statement, to be issued by the processor to the database.

Support Fragmented Transactions.name: Support Fragmented Transactions
Support Fragmented Transactions.description: If true, when a FlowFile is consumed by this Processor, the Processor will first check the fragment.identifier and fragment.count attributes of that FlowFile. If the fragment.count value is greater than 1, the Processor will not process any FlowFile with that fragment.identifier until all are available; at that point, it will process all FlowFiles with that fragment.identifier as a single transaction, in the order specified by the FlowFiles' fragment.index attributes. This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. If this value is false, these attributes will be ignored and the updates will occur independent of one another.

database-session-autocommit.name: database-session-autocommit
database-session-autocommit.description: The autocommit mode to set on the database connection being used. If set to false, the operation(s) will be explicitly committed or rolled back (based on success or failure respectively), if set to true the driver/database handles the commit/rollback.

Transaction Timeout.name: Transaction Timeout
Transaction Timeout.description: If the <Support Fragmented Transactions> property is set to true, specifies how long to wait for all FlowFiles for a particular fragment.identifier attribute to arrive before just transferring all of the FlowFiles with that identifier to the 'failure' relationship

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The preferred number of FlowFiles to put to the database in a single transaction

Obtain Generated Keys.name: Obtain Generated Keys
Obtain Generated Keys.description: If true, any key that is automatically generated by the database will be added to the FlowFile that generated it using the sql.generate.key attribute. This may result in slightly slower performance and is not supported by all databases.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated and retrying the operation will also fail, such as an invalid query or an integrity constraint violation

relationships.name: retry
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated but attempting the operation again may succeed

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship after the database is successfully updated

SELECT
    main.monthkey,
    main.`date`,
    main.monthkey,
    main.`year`,
    main.nhomvb_ma,
    main.nhomvb,
    main.ma_nv_cha,
	main.`Code`,
	main.idnv,
	main.tennv_viettat,
    main.Ma,
    main.TenNhiemVu,
    main.SanPhamChuYeu,
    main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
    main.NgayHoanThanh,

    /* các cột còn lại */
    main.TinhTrang,
    main.TienDoHoanThanh,
    CASE
        /* chưa hoàn thành nhưng đã quá hạn */
        WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh < CURDATE()
        THEN DATEDIFF(
                      CURDATE(),
                      main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
                         )

        /* đã hoàn thành nhưng quá hạn */
        WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.NgayHoanThanh > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
        THEN DATEDIFF(
                      main.NgayHoanThanh,
                      main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
                         )

        ELSE NULL
    END AS songayquahan,
	main.tongtg_canxuly AS tongtg_canxuly,
	main.tongtg_daxuly AS tongtg_daxuly,
    -- main.songayquahan,
    main.don_vi_cap_01,
    main.loaicapcha,
	main.loaicap,
    main.don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
    main.loaicapcha_dvgiao,
    main.iddv_dvgiao,
    main.donvi_dvgiao,
    main.tenviettat_dvgiao,
    main.NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
    main.donvi_dvthuchien,
    main.DonViPhoiHop,
	main.iddv_dvchutri,
	main.DonViChuTri,
    main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    main.NgayVanBan,
	main.LinhVuc,
    main.Kieu,
	main.UuTien,
    main.KetQuaGhiChu,
	main.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
                /* TRẠNG THÁI SUY RA */
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						 AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
				-- NVU không hạn
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					CONCAT(main.TinhTrang,' đúng hạn')
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					CONCAT(main.TinhTrang,' trong hạn')
		END AS TrangThai,
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'CHT trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'CHT sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'CHT quá hạn'
				
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					'HT đúng hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					'CHT trong hạn'
		END AS  TrangThaiVietTat,
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'Chưa HT sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Chưa HT quá hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					'HT đúng hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					'Chưa HT trong hạn'
		END AS TrangThaiVietTat2,
                main.TenNhiemVu_Mobile,
    '${sync_ts}' AS syncdate

FROM (
    -- subquery của Tùng giữ nguyên
SELECT
        MAX(monthkey) AS monthkey,
				MAX(`date`) AS `date`,
        MAX(`month`) AS `month`,
				MAX(`year`) AS `year`,
        nhomvb_ma,
        MAX(nhomvb) AS nhomvb,
        MAX(ma_nv_cha) AS ma_nv_cha,
        -- SUBSTRING(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT LEFT(Ma,50) ORDER BY Ma SEPARATOR ', '),1,255) AS Ma,
				MIN(`Code`) AS `Code`,
				MIN(idnv) AS idnv,
				MIN(tennv_viettat) AS tennv_viettat,
				MIN(Ma) AS Ma,
        TenNhiemVu,
        MAX(SanPhamChuYeu) AS SanPhamChuYeu,
        MAX(ThoiHanHoanThanh) AS ThoiHanHoanThanh,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT( iddv) > 0 AND 
						COUNT( iddv)
                 = COUNT( CASE
                        WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                        THEN 1
                   END)
            THEN MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                THEN NgayHoanThanh
            END
						)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS NgayHoanThanh,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT( iddv) > 0 AND COUNT( iddv)
                 = COUNT( CASE
                        WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                        THEN 1
                   END)
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
            ELSE 'Chưa hoàn thành'
        END AS TinhTrang,
        CONCAT(ROUND(
               COUNT( CASE
                               WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                               THEN iddv
               END)
               * 100.0
               / NULLIF(COUNT( iddv), 0),
               0
            ),'%') AS TienDoHoanThanh,
        MAX(songayquahan) AS songayquahan,
				MAX(tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
				MAX(tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,
        don_vi_cap_01 AS don_vi_cap_01,
        loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
        don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao AS don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
        loaicapcha_dvgiao AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
        MAX(iddv_dvgiao) AS iddv_dvgiao,
        MAX(donvi_dvgiao) AS donvi_dvgiao,
        NULL AS tenviettat_dvgiao, -- MAX(tenviettat_dvgiao) AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
        SUBSTRING(GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT NguoiGiaoNhiemVu
            ORDER BY NguoiGiaoNhiemVu
            SEPARATOR '; '
        ),1,255) AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
				loaicap,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT donvi
            ORDER BY donvi
            SEPARATOR '; '
        ) AS donvi_dvthuchien,
        NULL AS DonViPhoiHop,
				MAX(iddv_dvchutri) AS iddv_dvchutri,
				MAX(DonViChuTri ) AS DonViChuTri,
        MAX(VanBanGiaoNhiemVu) AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
        MAX(NgayVanBan) AS NgayVanBan,
				IFNULL(MAX(LinhVuc),'Chưa xác định') AS LinhVuc,
        MAX(Kieu) AS Kieu,
				CASE MIN(
						CASE UuTien
								WHEN 'Hỏa tốc'      THEN 1
								WHEN 'Thượng khẩn'  THEN 2
								WHEN 'Khẩn'         THEN 3
								WHEN 'Thường'       THEN 4
								ELSE 5
						END
				)
						WHEN 1 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
						WHEN 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
						WHEN 3 THEN 'Khẩn'
						WHEN 4 THEN 'Thường'
						ELSE 'Không xác định'
				END AS UuTien,
        MAX(KetQuaGhiChu) AS KetQuaGhiChu,
				MAX(NhomPhamViNhiemVu) AS NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
				NULL AS TenNhiemVu_Mobile
    FROM qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan
		-- WHERE loaicapcha !='Thành ủy Hà Nội'
		-- AND iddv_dvgiao NOT IN (1307)
		-- AND iddv IN (698, 1775, 1790)
		-- OR loaicap IN ('Sở ngành','Xã, Phường')
    GROUP BY
				monthkey,
				TenNhiemVu,
				don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
				loaicapcha_dvgiao,
				don_vi_cap_01,
				loaicap,
				loaicapcha,
				`month`,
				nhomvb_ma,
				VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
        NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
        TenNhiemVu
) main
ORDER BY
		`year`,
		monthkey,
		`date`,
        TenNhiemVu,
		don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
        loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		don_vi_cap_01,
        loaicapcha,
        `month`,
        nhomvb_ma,
        VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
        TenNhiemVu

    `monthkey` = VALUES(`monthkey`),
    `date` = VALUES(`date`),
    `month` = VALUES(`month`),

    `ma_nv_cha` = VALUES(`ma_nv_cha`),

If this property is empty, the content of the incoming FlowFile is expected to contain a valid SQL statement, to be issued by the processor to the database.

Support Fragmented Transactions.name: Support Fragmented Transactions
Support Fragmented Transactions.description: If true, when a FlowFile is consumed by this Processor, the Processor will first check the fragment.identifier and fragment.count attributes of that FlowFile. If the fragment.count value is greater than 1, the Processor will not process any FlowFile with that fragment.identifier until all are available; at that point, it will process all FlowFiles with that fragment.identifier as a single transaction, in the order specified by the FlowFiles' fragment.index attributes. This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. If this value is false, these attributes will be ignored and the updates will occur independent of one another.

Transaction Timeout.description: If the <Support Fragmented Transactions> property is set to true, specifies how long to wait for all FlowFiles for a particular fragment.identifier attribute to arrive before just transferring all of the FlowFiles with that identifier to the 'failure' relationship

Obtain Generated Keys.description: If true, any key that is automatically generated by the database will be added to the FlowFile that generated it using the sql.generate.key attribute. This may result in slightly slower performance and is not supported by all databases.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_giaonv 

SELECT
		main.monthkey AS monthkey,
		main.`date` AS `date`,
		main.`month` AS `month`,
		main.`year` AS `year`,
		main.nhomvb_ma AS nhomvb_ma,
		main.nhomvb AS nhomvb,
		main.NhomNhiemVu AS NhomNhiemVu,
		main.ma_nv_cha AS ma_nv_cha,
		main.`Code` AS `Code`,
		CONCAT(LEFT(main.monthkey,4),'-',main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,'-',main.Ma) AS idnv,
		CONCAT(LEFT(main.monthkey,4),'-',main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,'-',LEFT(MD5(main.TenNhiemVu), 12)) AS tennv_viettat,

		NULL AS TenNhiemVu_Mobile,

FROM (
    SELECT
        /* 01 - monthkey: lấy theo ExpireDate dạng YYYYMM */
        DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m') + 0 AS monthkey,
        DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m%d') + 0 AS `date`,
				DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%m/%Y') AS `month`,
        DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y') + 0 AS `year`,
        /* 04 - Group + VB */
        /* COALESCE(rg4.ResolutionGroupId, rg3.ResolutionGroupId, rg2.ResolutionGroupId, rg1.ResolutionGroupId, rg.ResolutionGroupId) AS nhomvb_ma,
				CASE 
						WHEN COALESCE(rg4.`Name`, rg3.`Name`, rg2.`Name`, rg1.`Name`, rg.`Name`) = 'Văn bản chỉ đạo theo NQ 57' THEN 'Nghị quyết 57'
						ELSE COALESCE(rg4.`Name`, rg3.`Name`, rg2.`Name`, rg1.`Name`, rg.`Name`)
				END AS nhomvb, */
        rg.ResolutionGroupId AS nhomvb_ma,
				CASE 
						WHEN rg.`Name` = 'Văn bản chỉ đạo theo NQ 57' THEN 'Nghị quyết 57'
						ELSE rg.`Name`
				END AS nhomvb,
				t.NameGroup AS NhomNhiemVu,
        r.DocCode AS ma_vb,
        r.Compendium AS vb,
				
        /* 05 - Mã nhiệm vụ */
				t.`Code` AS `Code`,
        t.TaskId AS Ma,
				t.ParentId AS ma_nv_cha,
        /* 06 - Tên nhiệm vụ */
        CASE 
						WHEN t.Title LIKE '%<script>%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.Title, '<script>', 1))
						ELSE t.Title
				END AS TenNhiemVu,
        NULL AS SanPhamChuYeu,

        /* 07 - Thời hạn hoàn thành */
        t.ExpireDate AS ThoiHanHoanThanh,
				COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ApprovedDate) AS NgayHoanThanh,

        /* 08 - Tình trạng */
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
            ELSE 'Chưa hoàn thành'
        END AS TinhTrang,
				nvcd.nhiem_vu_cho_duyet AS nhiem_vu_cho_duyet,

        /* 09 - Tiến độ hoàn thành */
        CONCAT(t.Progress, '%') AS TienDoHoanThanh,

        /* 10 - Số ngày quá hạn */
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Status NOT IN (3,4) AND t.ExpireDate < NOW() 
                THEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), t.ExpireDate)
            WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND t.CompletedDate > t.ExpireDate
                THEN DATEDIFF(t.CompletedDate, t.ExpireDate)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS songayquahan,

        /* 11 - Đơn vị */
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 1 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 1 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 1 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 1 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 1 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS don_vi_cap_01_dvthuchien,
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 2 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 2 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 2 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 2 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 2 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 3 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS loaicap_dvthuchien,
				d.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvthuchien,
				IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvthuchien,
				IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvthuchien,
				d.ParentId AS iddv_captren_dvthuchien,
				IFNULL(u_giao.canbo_hoten ,'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
				CAST(
        CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS don_vi_cap_01,
				CAST(
        CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS loaicapcha,
				CAST(
				CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS loaicap,
				dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv,
				IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
				IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
				dv_giao.ParentId AS iddv_captren,
				IFNULL(u_thuchien.canbo_hoten ,'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiThucHien,
        NULL AS DonViPhoiHop,
				NULL AS iddv_dvchutri,
				NULL AS DonViChuTri,
				/* Bên tạo nhiệm vụ */
				IFNULL(u_taonv.don_vi_cap_01 ,'Chưa xác định') AS don_vi_cap_01_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.loaicapcha ,'Chưa xác định') AS loaicapcha_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.loaicap ,'Chưa xác định') AS loaicap_dvtaonv,
				u_taonv.iddv AS iddv_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.donvi ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.tenviettat ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvtaonv,
				u_taonv.iddv_captren AS iddv_captren_dvtaonv,
				t.CreateUser AS NguoiTaoNhiemVuID,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.canbo_hoten ,'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiTaoNhiemVu,

        /* 12 - Văn bản giao */
        CASE
            WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode,"Số ","")
						WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
				r.StartDate AS NgayVanBan,
				s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
        /* 13 - Ghi chú */
        NULL AS KetQuaGhiChu,
				rp.ReportId AS ReportId,
				rp.Content AS NoiDungBaoCao,
				rp.CreatedDate AS ThoiDiemBaoCao,

        /* 14 - Trạng thái chi tiết */
        CASE
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND DATE( COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) )  <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
								THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate))  > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
								THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= DATE(NOW()) AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) > 5
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < DATE(NOW())
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= DATE(NOW()) AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) <= 5 
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn'
						ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
				END AS TrangThai,
				CASE
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN
								DATEDIFF(
										COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate),
										t.CreatedDate
								)
						ELSE NULL
				END AS tongtg_daxuly,
				DATEDIFF(
						t.ExpireDate,
						t.CreatedDate
				) AS tongtg_canxuly,
				CASE
						WHEN r.Type = 1  THEN 'Chỉ thị'
						WHEN r.Type = 2  THEN 'Nghị quyết'
						WHEN r.Type = 3  THEN 'Công văn'
						WHEN r.Type = 4  THEN 'Kết luận'
						WHEN r.Type = 5  THEN 'Thông báo'
						WHEN r.Type = 6  THEN 'Đề nghị'
						WHEN r.Type = 7  THEN 'Quyết định'
						WHEN r.Type = 8  THEN 'Báo cáo'
						WHEN r.Type = 9  THEN 'Quy định'
						WHEN r.Type = 10 THEN 'Hợp đồng'
						WHEN r.Type = 11 THEN 'Đăng ký'
						WHEN r.Type = 12 THEN 'Biên bản'
						WHEN r.Type = 13 THEN 'Quy trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 14 THEN 'Hướng dẫn'
						WHEN r.Type = 15 THEN 'Kiến nghị'
						WHEN r.Type = 16 THEN 'Thanh tra'
						WHEN r.Type = 17 THEN 'Tờ trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 18 THEN 'Giấy phép'
						WHEN r.Type = 19 THEN 'Giấy mời'
						WHEN r.Type = 20 THEN 'Danh sách'
						WHEN r.Type = 21 THEN 'Kế hoạch'
						WHEN r.Type = 22 THEN 'Chương trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 23 THEN 'Giấy uỷ quyền'
						WHEN r.Type = 24 THEN 'Đề án'
						WHEN r.Type = 25 THEN 'Thông tư'
						WHEN r.Type = 26 THEN 'Quy chế'
						ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
				END AS Kieu,
				CASE
            WHEN t.Priority = 3 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
            WHEN t.Priority = 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
						WHEN t.Priority = 1 THEN 'Khẩn'
            ELSE 'Thường'
        END AS UuTien

    FROM ( SELECT * FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task WHERE `Status` <> 5 AND DeletedDate IS NULL ) t
    LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d 
           ON d.DepartmentIdExt = t.TargetDepartment
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
				ON d1.DepartmentId = d.ParentId
		/* Cha */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
				ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId
		/* Ông */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
				ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId
		/* Cụ */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4
				ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId

		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao
           ON dv_giao.DepartmentIdExt = t.AssignDepartment
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao1
    ON dv_giao1.DepartmentId = dv_giao.ParentId
		/* Cha */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao2
				ON dv_giao2.DepartmentId = dv_giao1.ParentId
		/* Ông */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao3
				ON dv_giao3.DepartmentId = dv_giao2.ParentId
		/* Cụ */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao4
				ON dv_giao4.DepartmentId = dv_giao3.ParentId
				
		/* Đơn vị tạo nhiệm vụ */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_taonv
        ON dv_taonv.DepartmentIdExt = t.CreateUserDepartment
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_taonv1
				ON dv_taonv1.DepartmentId = dv_taonv.ParentId
		/* Cha */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_taonv2
				ON dv_taonv2.DepartmentId = dv_taonv1.ParentId
		/* Ông */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_taonv3
				ON dv_taonv3.DepartmentId = dv_taonv2.ParentId
		/* Cụ */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_taonv4
				ON dv_taonv4.DepartmentId = dv_taonv3.ParentId
		/* Người giao nhiệm vụ */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.dm_user u_giao
           ON u_giao.canbo_id = t.AssignUser
 		/* Người nhận nhiệm vụ */
 		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.dm_user u_thuchien
           ON u_thuchien.canbo_id = t.TargetUser
 		/* Người tạo nhiệm vụ */
		LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.dm_user u_taonv
           ON u_taonv.canbo_id = t.CreateUser
					 
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r 
           ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s
           ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg
           ON r.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ResolutionGroupId
		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg1 ON rg1.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ParentGroupId 
		AND rg1.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 2: cha của cha
		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg2 ON rg2.ResolutionGroupId = rg1.ParentGroupId 
		AND rg2.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 3: cha của cha
		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg3 ON rg3.ResolutionGroupId = rg2.ParentGroupId 
		AND rg3.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 4: cha của cha
		LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg4 ON rg4.ResolutionGroupId = rg3.ParentGroupId 
		AND rg4.IsRoot = 0
    LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nhiem_vu_cho_duyet_copy nvcd
           ON nvcd.taskid = t.Taskid
			LEFT JOIN (
			    SELECT rp1.TaskId, rp1.ReportId, rp1.Content, rp1.CreatedDate
			    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp1
			    JOIN (
			        SELECT rpx.TaskId, MAX(rpx.ReportId) AS max_id
			        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rpx
			        WHERE rpx.DeletedDate IS NULL
			          AND rpx.CreatedDate = (
			              SELECT MAX(rpy.CreatedDate)
			              FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rpy
			              WHERE rpy.TaskId = rpx.TaskId
			                AND rpy.DeletedDate IS NULL
			          )
			        GROUP BY rpx.TaskId
			    ) rp2 ON rp1.ReportId = rp2.max_id
			) rp ON rp.TaskId = t.TaskId
		/*
    WHERE 
        t.Status <> 5
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
		*/

) main
WHERE ( (
		(
				main.loaicapcha = 'UBND Thành phố'
				AND ( ( main.loaicap NOT IN ('Sở ngành','Xã, Phường','Nhóm Sở ngành mở rộng') ) OR main.loaicap IS NULL )
		)
		OR
		(
				main.loaicapcha = 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				AND main.loaicap <> 'Đảng bộ trực thuộc'
		)
		OR
		(
				main.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
		)
		OR
		(
				main.loaicapcha = 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
		) )
		-- OR (main.don_vi_cap_01 = 'BAN TỔ CHỨC TRUNG ƯƠNG') 
      )
 ORDER BY 
    main.`year`,
    main.monthkey,
    main.`date`,
    main.Ma

    `date` = VALUES(`date`),
    `month` = VALUES(`month`),

sql-pre-query.name: sql-pre-query
sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

Database Connection Pooling Service.name: Database Connection Pooling Service
Database Connection Pooling Service.description: The Controller Service that is used to obtain connection to database

sql-pre-query.name: sql-pre-query
sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated and retrying the operation will also fail, such as an invalid query or an integrity constraint violation

relationships.name: retry
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated but attempting the operation again may succeed

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship after the database is successfully updated

JDBC Connection Pool.name: JDBC Connection Pool
JDBC Connection Pool.description: Specifies the JDBC Connection Pool to use in order to convert the JSON message to a SQL statement. The Connection Pool is necessary in order to determine the appropriate database column types.

putsql-sql-statement.name: putsql-sql-statement
putsql-sql-statement.description: The SQL statement to execute. The statement can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming FlowFiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming FlowFile is expected to contain a valid SQL statement, to be issued by the processor to the database.

Support Fragmented Transactions.name: Support Fragmented Transactions
Support Fragmented Transactions.description: If true, when a FlowFile is consumed by this Processor, the Processor will first check the fragment.identifier and fragment.count attributes of that FlowFile. If the fragment.count value is greater than 1, the Processor will not process any FlowFile with that fragment.identifier until all are available; at that point, it will process all FlowFiles with that fragment.identifier as a single transaction, in the order specified by the FlowFiles' fragment.index attributes. This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. If this value is false, these attributes will be ignored and the updates will occur independent of one another.

database-session-autocommit.name: database-session-autocommit
database-session-autocommit.description: The autocommit mode to set on the database connection being used. If set to false, the operation(s) will be explicitly committed or rolled back (based on success or failure respectively), if set to true the driver/database handles the commit/rollback.

Transaction Timeout.name: Transaction Timeout
Transaction Timeout.description: If the <Support Fragmented Transactions> property is set to true, specifies how long to wait for all FlowFiles for a particular fragment.identifier attribute to arrive before just transferring all of the FlowFiles with that identifier to the 'failure' relationship

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The preferred number of FlowFiles to put to the database in a single transaction

Obtain Generated Keys.name: Obtain Generated Keys
Obtain Generated Keys.description: If true, any key that is automatically generated by the database will be added to the FlowFile that generated it using the sql.generate.key attribute. This may result in slightly slower performance and is not supported by all databases.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.
